title: DTCA Panel
summary: The public DTCA tracker page is reachable, but it does not expose a public JSON feed or an iframe-safe live data endpoint. KoyJabo now keeps a refreshable snapshot and opens the official tracker for the latest live view.
busHints: Open the official DTCA tracker for the latest live map
Use the app card as a quick shortcut to the official experience
snippet: Live bus data is not available through a public API from this source, so the app uses a snapshot fallback and direct-link access.
